defmodule WebSocketServer.Application do
  use Application

  def start(_type, _args) do
    config = WebSocketServer.Config.load()
    children = [
      {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: WebSocketServer.Router, options: [port: config.port, dispatch: dispatch()]}
    ]
    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: WebSocketServer.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end

  defp dispatch do
    [
      {:_, [
        {"/ws", WebSocketServer.SocketHandler, []},
        {:_, Plug.Cowboy.Handler, {WebSocketServer.Router, []}}
      ]}
    ]
  end
end

defmodule WebSocketServer.Config do
  defstruct [:port, :max_payload_bytes, :max_decompressed_bytes, :decompression_ratio_limit]

  def load do
    env = System.get_env("WS_ENV", "production")
    base_config = %__MODULE__{
      port: String.to_integer(System.get_env("WS_PORT", "4000")),
      max_payload_bytes: 10_485_760,
      max_decompressed_bytes: 104_857_600,
      decompression_ratio_limit: 10
    }
    apply_env_overrides(base_config, env)
  end

  defp apply_env_overrides(config, "development") do
    %{config |
      max_payload_bytes: 52_428_800,
      max_decompressed_bytes: 524_288_000,
      decompression_ratio_limit: 100
    }
  end

  defp apply_env_overrides(config, "staging") do
    %{config |
      max_payload_bytes: 20_971_520,
      max_decompressed_bytes: 209_715_200,
      decompression_ratio_limit: 50
    }
  end

  defp apply_env_overrides(config, _production) do
    config
  end
end

defmodule WebSocketServer.DecompressionGuard do
  @moduledoc """
  Provides safe decompression with ratio and size limits.
  Uses streaming decompression to detect bombs early.
  """

  def safe_decompress(compressed_data, config) do
    compressed_size = byte_size(compressed_data)

    if compressed_size > config.max_payload_bytes do
      {:error, :payload_too_large}
    else
      stream_decompress(compressed_data, config, compressed_size)
    end
  end

  defp stream_decompress(data, config, compressed_size) do
    z = :zlib.open()
    :ok = :zlib.inflateInit(z)

    try do
      result = do_inflate(z, data, config, compressed_size, <<>>, 0)
      :zlib.inflateEnd(z)
      result
    catch
      _kind, _reason -> {:error, :decompression_failed}
    after
      :zlib.close(z)
    end
  end

  defp do_inflate(z, data, config, compressed_size, acc, total_bytes) do
    chunk_size = 65_536
    chunks = for <<chunk::binary-size(chunk_size) <- data>>, do: chunk
    remainder_size = rem(byte_size(data), chunk_size)
    chunks = if remainder_size > 0 do
      chunks ++ [binary_part(data, byte_size(data) - remainder_size, remainder_size)]
    else
      chunks
    end

    process_chunks(z, chunks, config, compressed_size, acc, total_bytes)
  end

  defp process_chunks(_z, [], _config, _compressed_size, acc, _total_bytes) do
    {:ok, acc}
  end

  defp process_chunks(z, [chunk | rest], config, compressed_size, acc, total_bytes) do
    inflated = IO.iodata_to_binary(:zlib.inflate(z, chunk))
    new_total = total_bytes + byte_size(inflated)

    current_ratio = if compressed_size > 0, do: new_total / compressed_size, else: 0

    cond do
      new_total > config.max_decompressed_bytes ->
        {:error, :decompressed_too_large}
      check_ratio_exceeded(current_ratio, config) ->
        {:error, :suspicious_ratio}
      true ->
        process_chunks(z, rest, config, compressed_size, acc <> inflated, new_total)
    end
  end

  defp check_ratio_exceeded(current_ratio, config) do
    current_ratio > config.decompression_ratio_limit * 1.0
  end
end

defmodule WebSocketServer.SocketHandler do
  @behaviour :cowboy_websocket

  def init(req, state) do
    {:cowboy_websocket, req, state, %{idle_timeout: 60_000}}
  end

  def websocket_init(state) do
    config = WebSocketServer.Config.load()
    {:ok, Map.put(state || %{}, :config, config)}
  end

  def websocket_handle({:binary, data}, state) do
    config = state.config
    case detect_and_decompress(data, config) do
      {:ok, decompressed} ->
        response = process_message(decompressed)
        {:reply, {:text, response}, state}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)})}, state}
    end
  end

  def websocket_handle({:text, text}, state) do
    response = process_message(text)
    {:reply, {:text, response}, state}
  end

  def websocket_handle(_frame, state), do: {:ok, state}

  def websocket_info(_info, state), do: {:ok, state}

  defp detect_and_decompress(data, config) do
    case detect_compression(data) do
      :zlib -> WebSocketServer.DecompressionGuard.safe_decompress(data, config)
      :gzip -> decompress_gzip(data, config)
      :none -> {:ok, data}
    end
  end

  defp detect_compression(<<0x78, second, _rest::binary>>) when second in [0x01, 0x5E, 0x9C, 0xDA] do
    :zlib
  end
  defp detect_compression(<<0x1F, 0x8B, _rest::binary>>), do: :gzip
  defp detect_compression(_), do: :none

  defp decompress_gzip(data, config) do
    compressed_size = byte_size(data)
    if compressed_size > config.max_payload_bytes do
      {:error, :payload_too_large}
    else
      try do
        decompressed = :zlib.gunzip(data)
        decompressed_size = byte_size(decompressed)
        ratio = decompressed_size / max(compressed_size, 1)

        cond do
          decompressed_size > config.max_decompressed_bytes ->
            {:error, :decompressed_too_large}
          ratio > config.decompression_ratio_limit * 1.0 ->
            {:error, :suspicious_ratio}
          true ->
            {:ok, decompressed}
        end
      catch
        _kind, _reason -> {:error, :decompression_failed}
      end
    end
  end

  defp process_message(data) do
    case Jason.decode(data) do
      {:ok, msg} -> Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", echo: msg})
      {:error, _} -> Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", raw_size: byte_size(data)})
    end
  end
end
